invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieData<T> instance, specifically HoodieListData.eager(data), which should not be null.
data is passed directly to HoodieListData.eager(data), so it must be non-null to avoid NullPointerException.
The returned value is always the result of HoodieListData.eager(data), thus it must be of type HoodieListData.
The eager method constructs HoodieListData with the input list, so collecting as list from the result should yield the original data.
It makes sense for the method to require a positive parallelism, otherwise parallelization is ill-defined.
